news.t: BTC slipped below 63,000 and broke out of the 64,000-66,000 range it had held since 15 Nov. Fed Governor Waller said on CNBC that he argues for a 50 basis point hike in December. CME FedWatch still shows over 95% odds of a 25 basis point hike, and his remarks did not change that. An analyst cited in the article put spot Bitcoin ETF net outflows at $2.1 billion since early 2026 and $8.7 billion over 30 days (his numbers, not checked).

On 18 Nov BTC was near 64,100 while Nvidia beat estimates and raised its outlook, lifting Nasdaq-100 futures 1.0%. Bitcoin did not follow the stock rally. The yield on the crypto basis trade fell to about 3-5% a year, near or below Treasury yields. Liquidations were $377.4 million over 24 hours. Fear and Greed was 13, extreme fear. The October FOMC minutes were due at 19:00 UTC, which is 03:00 HK on 19 Nov.

Context from the weekend: BTC hit about 62,000, its lowest since July, and liquidations were $2.02 billion in 24 hours on 14-15 Nov. US spot Bitcoin ETFs had $1.91 billion of net outflows over seven straight sessions through Friday 13 Nov.
Not read: a 19 Nov FXStreet headline says hawkish Fed minutes reinforce a December rate hike. The page would not load, so I only have the headline, not what the minutes said.

news.t: BTC traded near 65,000 on Monday between a 63,800 low and a 65,600 high, after a weekend low near 62,000. Nasdaq fell about 2.5% and Nvidia about 4%, after CNBC reported its board is not considering bringing back CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned last week.

The dollar index hit its highest level since April 2025, the 10-year yield eased to about 5.12%, and gold fell to its lowest since October 2025. This matches the broad USD strength on your forex charts.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs had $185m of outflows on Friday, a seventh straight day of outflows.
Fed Chair Warsh gave no guidance on the near-term path. Futures imply a quarter-point hike in December. The Fed held at 3.75% to 4% by a 10-2 vote, with Cook and Hammack preferring a hike.
BTC is down 17% in November, a sixth straight weekly decline. Fear and Greed is at extreme fear.
JPMorgan estimates about $2.8bn of possible index-fund selling when MSCI removes Strategy (MSTR) at the close on 30 Nov.
Dates in HK time: US retail sales Tue 17 Nov 21:30; Nvidia results after the US close, about 05:00 Wed 18 Nov (time approximate); Fed minutes Thu 19 Nov 03:00; December Fed decision Thu 10 Dec 03:00.
